lines.text: Hi. I'm the one who makes this game, so for a few minutes I get to live in it too.
This is Fantasia4x. Every world is a new valley grown from a seed, with lakes, meadows, cliffs and forest, and deer dozing by the water.
I don't steer anyone by hand. I mark trees to cut, lay out a yard and a bench, and the settlers sort out who does what.
Up here is everything we own and make, from flint knives to oak logs. I keep it plain so the world stays the main thing.
The valley isn't empty. Elk wander the woods, and one day we'll have to decide whether to leave them be or go hunting.
Weather comes and goes. Rain slows the work down, and the wind moves every tree and every stalk of grass.
Some trees are older than the rest, and a few of them are not quite ordinary.
Days turn into evenings, the light goes gold, and people drift back toward the fire.
That's where it stands today. Thanks for spending a little time in the valley with me. See you in the next one.
